summary: [QuickBooks Online] events: Event Notifications (webhooks) for create/update/delete/void/merge on ~24 entities; Change Data Capture (GET .../cdc?entities=..&changedSince=.., 30-day window, 1000/request) for sync/backfill/reconnect. Webhook payloads carry entity+operation+company only; follow-up fetch required. CloudEvents payload migration deadline 2026-07-31.
